title_zh: 我们跟库克聊了聊 iPhone Duo
content_zh:
10 月 11 日，蒂姆·库克在广州与 APPSO 交流 iPhone Duo 的应用适配时表示，开发者应充分利用更大、更具沉浸感的屏幕，探索不同使用方式，并考虑用户不同的握持角度。

APPSO 在现场看到，Xmind 为 iPhone Duo 制作的广州美食地图会随设备开合形态变化。Xmind 团队介绍，他们用半个月完成了适配，并针对铰链设计了「半屏展示」大纲模式，让思维导图与大纲分屏协同；库克也对这一适配给予肯定。

APPSO 还观察到，部分应用在使用过程中，系统会在铰链两侧增加间距，确保交互区域避开折痕。折叠形态带来的布局变化，成为这次现场交流的重点。

同日，广东省省长孟凡利在广州会见库克一行。库克表示，广东对苹果在华发展至关重要，愿进一步扩大在粤业务布局，围绕供应链、创新生态、智能制造和绿色制造、销售渠道等方面探讨合作。

🔗 相关阅读：刚刚，我跟库克聊了聊 iPhone Duo
title_en: Tim Cook Discusses iPhone Duo App Adaptation and Supply Chain Expansion in Guangzhou
content_en:
During a recent meeting in Guangzhou, Apple CEO Tim Cook shared insights on app adaptation for the iPhone Duo with tech media APPSO. Cook emphasized that developers should fully leverage the larger, immersive screen, explore novel interaction methods, and account for varying user grip angles.

In a live demonstration, developer Xmind showcased a Guangzhou food map app that dynamically adapts to the device's folding states. To accommodate the hinge, Xmind created a split-screen outline mode alongside mind mapping, earning praise from Cook. Observers also noted system-level adjustments that add spacing near the hinge to keep interactive elements clear of the crease.

On the same day, Cook met with Guangdong Governor Meng Fanli. Cook highlighted Guangdong’s pivotal role in Apple's Chinese operations and expressed strong interest in expanding local investments across supply chains, innovation ecosystems, smart manufacturing, and retail channels.

title_zh: 曝苹果与 ADT 合作，为家居中枢提供安装服务
content_zh:
据 MacRumors 报道，苹果可能与美国家庭安防公司 ADT 建立合作，为即将推出的智能家居中枢及相关配件提供上门安装服务。苹果已邀请媒体于 10 月 13 日参加纽约的「Welcome home」活动，报道推测，合作可能在当天公布。

报道援引 ADT 近几个月招聘的低压技术员说法。部分新员工称，入职后主要跟随其他技术员学习，尚未获知完整职责；一些员工及经理签署了相关保密协议。这批员工获得的是 iPhone 工作机，而其他技术员使用 Android 设备。

另有新员工被告知，岗位涉及家庭自动化及上门安装。原定 9 月说明的工作细节也被延至 10 月。报道据此推测，ADT 技术员可能负责安装壁挂式家居中枢，或苹果与 LG 等品牌合作开发的配件。

上述合作仍属传闻，是否涵盖家庭安防监控也尚无确认。MacRumors 同时援引知情人士称，ADT 与 Google 的独家协议近期已经到期，且不会续约；Google 正转向与 AT&T 合作。
title_en: Apple Reportedly Partners with ADT for Smart Home Hub Installations
content_en:
Apple may be partnering with U.S. home security provider ADT to offer professional in-home installation services for its upcoming smart home hub and accessories, according to *MacRumors*. The collaboration is expected to be unveiled at Apple's upcoming "Welcome Home" media event in New York City.

Recent hiring activities at ADT point toward the partnership, with new low-voltage technicians reportedly undergoing training under non-disclosure agreements. Unlike standard technicians who use Android devices, these new recruits were issued iPhones and informed that their responsibilities would involve home automation and on-site installations for wall-mounted hubs and accessory hardware.

This potential alliance follows the recent expiration of ADT’s exclusive partnership with Google. While details remain unconfirmed, the move highlights Apple's strategy to streamline physical deployment and eliminate friction for adoption of its smart home ecosystem.

title_zh: 蔚来广东换电站达到 500 座，六城同步新增第五代站
content_zh:
10 月 11 日，蔚来宣布，广州、深圳、惠州、东莞、佛山和珠海六座城市同步上线六座第五代换电站，广东换电站数量达到 500 座。

据悉，广东蔚来换电站累计提供的换电服务已超过 1700 万次。第五代站此次在六城同时落地，继续扩展省内换电网络。

截至 10 月 11 日，蔚来全国充换电站合计 9584 座，其中换电站 4176 座；高速公路网络已部署 1073 座换电站，覆盖「9 纵 11 横 16 大城市群」，连通超过 550 座城市。
title_en: NIO Hits 500 Battery Swap Stations in Guangdong with Launch of 5th-Gen Stations
content_en:
Electric vehicle manufacturer NIO has officially hit the milestone of 500 battery swap stations in Guangdong Province, following the simultaneous deployment of its fifth-generation swap stations across six major cities: Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Huizhou, Dongguan, Foshan, and Zhuhai.

Guangdong represents one of NIO's largest markets, with cumulative battery swaps in the province exceeding 17 million services. The deployment of the fifth-generation stations significantly boosts regional charging and swapping density.

Nationwide, NIO's energy footprint continues to scale rapidly. The company now operates 9,584 charging and swapping stations across China, including 4,176 swap stations. Its highway network alone features 1,073 swap stations, interconnecting more than 550 cities across major highway corridors and metropolitan clusters.

title_zh: Laika 定格动画《Wildwood》首映，开发历时 16 年
content_zh:
10 月 11 日，Laika 定格动画电影《Wildwood》在 BFI 伦敦电影节举行世界首映。导演 Travis Knight 与配音演员 Carey Mulligan、Peyton Elizabeth Lee 和 Jacob Tremblay 出席，Knight 在现场回顾了这部奇幻长片历时 16 年的开发过程。

影片改编自 Colin Meloy 与 Carson Ellis 的原作，Laika 取得改编权后开发多年，于 2021 年进入制作。Knight 形容定格动画的工作：团队造出数以千计的微缩物件，布光、拍照，再把物件移动极小的距离，然后继续拍照，如此反复，直到电影完成。

他在台上开玩笑说，项目启动时，奥巴马还是第一任期的新总统；这段时间足够让自己读完两次医学院，当年出生的孩子如今都能开车送他来参加首映。

据 Variety 报道，《Wildwood》将于 10 月 23 日由 Fathom Entertainment 在美国发行、Black Bear 在英国发行，也是 Laika 首部获得 PG-13 分级的长片。
title_en: Laika Debuts Stop-Motion Feature 'Wildwood' After 16-Year Journey
content_en:
Animation studio Laika officially debuted its latest stop-motion feature, *Wildwood*, at the BFI London Film Festival. Director Travis Knight attended the world premiere alongside voice actors Carey Mulligan, Peyton Elizabeth Lee, and Jacob Tremblay, reflecting on the fantasy film's ambitious 16-year development process.

Adapted from the novel by Colin Meloy and Carson Ellis, the project entered physical production in 2021 following years of development. Knight highlighted the meticulous craft behind the stop-motion technique, describing how the team created thousands of miniature props, arranged precise lighting, and repeatedly adjusted objects by micro-distances frame by frame to bring the story to life.

According to *Variety*, *Wildwood* is scheduled for release on October 23, distributed by Fathom Entertainment in the United States and Black Bear in the United Kingdom. It also marks Laika's first feature film to receive a PG-13 rating.

title_zh: 《银翼杀手 2099》发布新预告，杨紫琼与亨特·莎弗追查复制人失踪案
content_zh:
Prime Video 在纽约漫展发布《银翼杀手 2099》新预告，官方预告页面确认，这部由杨紫琼、亨特·莎弗主演的限定剧将于 11 月 25 日上线。

故事设定在《银翼杀手 2049》的 50 年后：复制人起义已经发生，人类失去主导地位。杨紫琼饰演的复制人银翼杀手 Olwen 正在追查一名失踪同僚，她自身的寿命也即将结束；莎弗饰演的人类角色则为保护弟弟，潜入洛杉矶警局并假扮银翼杀手。

主创在现场介绍，这一悬疑搭档关系贯穿剧集。布景大量采用 360 度空间，把灯光、可互动屏幕和机械装置放入场景；Olwen 指甲呈现的异常颜色，则呼应了第一部电影对复制人生命衰退的视觉表现。
title_en: Prime Video Drops New 'Blade Runner 2099' Trailer Starring Michelle Yeoh and Hunter Schafer
content_en:
Prime Video unveiled a new trailer for *Blade Runner 2099* during New York Comic Con, confirming that the limited series starring Michelle Yeoh and Hunter Schafer will premiere on November 25.

Set 50 years after the events of *Blade Runner 2049*, the narrative takes place in a world where a replicant uprising has stripped humanity of its dominant position. Yeoh stars as Olwen, a replicant Blade Runner reaching the end of her lifespan while investigating a missing colleague. Schafer plays a human who poses as a Blade Runner within the LAPD to protect her younger brother.

The show's creators emphasized the central mystery partnership driving the plot, revealing that production utilized immersive 360-degree sets built with interactive screens and practical mechanical devices. Key visual touches, such as subtle discoloration on Olwen's nails, pay homage to the original film's depiction of replicant decay.
